milestone_brief:
Fix the desktop supervisor's missing window and stop window-ready from claiming one that does not exist (issue #423).

VERIFIED ROOT CAUSE. As committed, apps/desktop/crates/supervisor/src/main.rs builds the main window in setup() with WebviewWindowBuilder::new(app, "main", WebviewUrl::External(starting)).title("arXMCP").build(). Tauri registers the window object -- get_webview_window("main") returns Some, navigate() succeeds, and WebviewWindow::is_visible() returns Ok(true) -- but no native window is ever created. Measured with System Events window counts, positive-controlled in the same run against known-windowed apps (Ghostty 1, Google Chrome 2): the committed build owns 0 windows.

VERIFIED FIX DIRECTION. Adding .visible(true) to the builder plus show() and set_focus() on the built window produces a real native macOS window titled arXMCP that renders the child's /ui/ console. This was measured, not theorised. The minimal sufficient subset of those three calls has NOT been determined -- determine it rather than applying all three by default.

SECOND DEFECT, EQUALLY IMPORTANT. lifecycle.rs emits the window-ready event after navigate_window() succeeds. navigate_window only proves Tauri's window registry has an entry and navigation did not error; it proves nothing about a native window existing. window-ready therefore fired in every run where no window existed. Either make the event conditional on an observation that a window really exists, or rename/remove it so no event claims what it cannot establish.

EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE, BINDING. Any test or probe that concludes a window is absent MUST first prove, in the same run, that it can observe a window that is present. Issue #423 was filed using CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo without that control; the call returned null for lack of Screen Recording permission and the loop produced an empty list for every application on the machine, which was misread as verified absence. A regression that cannot distinguish permission-denied from window-absent is worse than no regression, because it closes the issue while the defect remains.

SCOPE. apps/desktop/crates/supervisor/src/main.rs, apps/desktop/crates/supervisor/src/lifecycle.rs, and a regression test. Update apps/desktop/README.md only if a claim there becomes false. Do not touch server/**, do not change the control contract, do not alter the MCP surface.
